title: Search For Facet Values: SearchBox translations
body:
Use Case: I want to change the placeholder of the SearchBox used for SFFV in the RefinementList/Menu

```js
<RefinementList attributeName="category" searchForFacetValues
                    translations={{placeholder: 'Search for products'}}/>
```

Behavior: Nothing happen

***

This is happening because the `translate` function we built for the RefinementList/Menu is overridden by the one built for the `<SearchBox/>`.

I see two ways for fixing this:

* We do not override the first translate function built. It means that if a component A use a component B, then every translations should already have been taken care of by the component A.

* We forward the `translations` props to every widgets (it's not the case today, we use this props to build the `translate` props, but we do not forward the `translations`object). It means that if a component A uses a component B, then he will need to forward the `translations` keys props to the component B, in order for it to build the correct `translate` function.

In either case, we need to add the `<SearchBox/>` translations propTypes to the `<RefinementList/>/<Menu/>`.
